Privacy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy explains what happens to the information you share with the Laramie Dunn Team · RealtyPath LLC (Tooele Valley) through this website. We've kept it plain on purpose.

What we collect

If you fill out a form on this site, we collect what you type into it: your name, and whichever of your email address and phone number you provide, plus any message you send. Our server also records the page you submitted from and basic technical details of the request (such as the time and your network address) to help prevent spam.

This site does not run analytics, advertising trackers, or third-party cookies.

How we use it

We use what you send to respond to you about buying or selling real estate. When you submit a form, a copy is stored securely and forwarded to us so we can follow up. We do not sell your information, and we don't share it except as needed to work with you (for example, with our brokerage, RealtyPath LLC (Tooele Valley), or service providers who help us operate) or where the law requires it.

Text and email

If you give us your phone number or email, you're agreeing that we may contact you there about your inquiry. You can ask us to stop at any time and we will.

Seeing or deleting your information

You can ask us what we have on file for you, or ask us to delete it. Email lisaneilrealty@gmail.com and we'll take care of it.

Changes

If we update this policy, we'll change the date at the top of this page.

Contact

Questions about privacy? Email lisaneilrealty@gmail.com.
